scenarios.scenario_name: Switch to standard Linux Operating System
scenarios.reasoning: Application already runs on RHEL (Red Hat Enterprise Linux), a standard enterprise Linux distribution. The OS type is standard — the issue is the outdated version, not the OS family.

WebSphere 7.0 reached EOL in April 2015 — over a decade ago. This is a critical security and operational risk. Replacement with a modern application server (or vendor-provided alternative) is urgent. Note: as 3rd party software, replacement must align with vendor's supported stack.
triggered_by: Application Server Status is End of Life
Application Server has no vendor support

scenarios.scenario_name: Application Migration to Cloud Infrastructure (Lift & Shift)
scenarios.reasoning: Application is already deployed on AWS cloud infrastructure with Amazon RDS MySQL as the managed database. Cloud migration is already accomplished.

scenarios.scenario_name: Switch DB Engine to open-source database solution
scenarios.reasoning: Amazon RDS MySQL is already an open-source database engine with no commercial licensing fee. No action needed.
